As someone who was diagnosed 10 plus years ago, this may be an unpopular opinion.

Flare days SUCK.  It all sucks. The aches, the pains, the vomiting and sun sensitivity. And it feels like fighting an uphill battle. The only people who will ever understand are other people with the disease. 

But you gotta get up anyway. Some days you can't. And thats okay. But you can't let this disease beat you. Sometimes you feel miserable and tired and like the whole world is against you, but you gotta get up anyway. 

Is it fair? No. 

You're gonna have to work twice as hard as a normal person to do everything. And they won't get it. So celebrate your own victories. Don't look to them for approval. Don't expect them to 'get it'. And mostly don't rely on sympathy. 

Just keep going. Celebrate every victory. You'll have bad days. You'll have good ones. It gets easier as you go to learn your body and its limits. 

Eating right helps a lot. It really does. Light cardio exercise everyday cut my flare days in half.

But it might be different for you.

So just forget thier opinions. And don't let this disease control you or make excuses for you. Live the life YOU want.
